stage_a_filter: accepted answer id resolves to an answer of this question in Posts.xml; title/body match lexical troubleshooting regex (se_common.TROUBLE_RE); question body >=20 words; >=1 pre-first-answer interaction candidate (any question comment, or any body edit in PostHistory, strictly before first answer)
cutoff_policy: min(first published answer, earliest non-owner question comment overlapping the accepted answer by >=2 distinctive 4-gram shingles); evidence strictly before cutoff
